statement: Under strict native compute query-gold-blind recruitment over a content-addressed heterogeneous hypothesis population improves strict oracle utilization and final pass@2 per compute over fixed order and equal-cost restart
evidence_required: Prospective fresh-cohort complement plus recruitment and final-selection gates
falsifier: No meaningful exclusive coverage or valid recruitment gain below 2 strict tasks and equal-cost controls

statement: Independent recursive and visual providers contribute complementary strict task-level candidate regions
evidence_required: A fresh family-disjoint 100-task cohort with at least 3 added-provider exclusive tasks from at least 3 sealed families
falsifier: Fewer than 3 exclusive families from the added provider

statement: Cheap query-blind task and anchor-state features can identify where invoking an expensive complementary provider has positive marginal value
evidence_required: After an independent complement gate passes, at 30 percent activation recover at least half the union gain and at least 2 tasks over anchor while beating controls
falsifier: Valid policy gains fewer than 2 tasks or does not beat equal-cost controls

statement: A verifier and selector can convert recruited oracle complement into final pass@2 without consuming the compute savings
evidence_required: Prospective final pass@2 gain under the same native cost ledger
falsifier: Oracle improves but final pass@2 does not
